headline: Micron pauses $4.5 billion Taiwan factory project amid labor dispute
summary: Micron Technology has paused a planned $4.5 billion factory expansion in Taoyuan, Taiwan, due to an ongoing labor dispute. The company stated that its current operations remain unaffected.
why: Micron is a critical supplier in the global semiconductor supply chain. Delays in capacity expansion can impact long-term supply projections for memory chips used in electronics and AI infrastructure.

impacts.name: Micron Technology
impacts.why: Operational delays and capital expenditure pauses can negatively affect growth outlooks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors typically react negatively to capital project delays, as they signal potential future supply constraints and increased operational costs.
